Title: Azure Arc support for Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) engine clusters

Body.Content:
Simplify and streamline your on-premises, edge and multicloud investments with the new capabilities of Azure Arc. Azure Arc-enabled Kubernetes is now available in preview to enable you to manage your Kubernetes clusters and applications anywhere.

Additionally, Microsoft will deliver Kubernetes clusters deployed through the Azure Kubernetes Service engine on Azure Stack Hub to be managed through Azure Arc beginning in summer 2020. This enables central management of your organization’s Kubernetes clusters, no matter where they’re hosted.

Learn more
